title: Dream Destination: Lanzerac Hotel & Spa in Stellenbosch wine country
content: <div class="author-description"><p>Carolyne is a freelance writer/editor/photographer based in Adelaide, South Australia. A wise woman (her mum) once told her: "The world is at your feet". Carolyne took her mum literally and has followed those feet all over the world and she has captured many of those destinations in words and images, inspiring others to follow in her footsteps, or warning them to tread carefully. Her work has been published in print, online via websites and social media and broadcast on Travel Writers Radio. She has also co-authored two books and created two travel apps.<br/>After a long career as production editor with News Corp, and editor of The Wanderer, Carolyne is now Footloose &amp; Fancy Freelance, specialising in the travel industry from writing and editing, to tour guiding, hosting and guest speaking on cruise ships.<br/>Her work has been published in Escape, escape.com.au, Australian Geographic, news.com.au, Selector magazine, Great Walks, Vacations &amp; Travel, Luxury Escapes, Senior Traveller, SA Weekend, Gold Coast Bulletin, Hipcamp, Future Adelaide, The Wanderer, Caravan World, Camper, Australian Traveller, NZ Herald, Asian Journeys, In Daily, Travel Writers Radio and soundcloud.com.</p></div>

title: Michelin ranks Bordeaux châteaux in new ‘grapes’ selection
content: <div class="author-description"><p>Chris Mercer is a Bristol-based freelance editor and journalist who spent nearly four years as digital editor of <strong>Decanter.com</strong>, having previously been <em>Decanter’s</em> news editor across online and print.</p><p>He has written about, and reported on, the wine and food sectors for more than 10 years for both consumer and trade media.</p><p>Chris first became interested in the wine world while living in Languedoc-Roussillon after completing a journalism Masters in the UK. These days, his love of wine commonly tests his budgeting skills.</p><p>Beyond wine, Chris also has an MSc in food policy and has a particular interest in sustainability issues. He has also been a food judge at the UK’s Great Taste Awards.</p></div>

content: <p>Sylvia Wu is Decanter's Regional Editor for Asia and Northern & Eastern Europe. She also works as the Editor of Decanter China platforms, overseeing Decanter’s China-focused editorial operation. Trained as a journalist at Beijing Foreign Studies University and the University of Leicester, Sylvia is fluent in English, Japanese and Mandarin. </p><p>After a career in advertising, she began her journey in wine with Decanter in 2012. A former non-drinker, she was immediately drawn to the astonishingly complex yet fascinating world of wine.</p><p>Now Decanter’s ‘Discovery’ Regional Editor, Sylvia is passionate about uncovering lesser-known stories beyond the classic regions and unearthing hidden gems in the wine world, while continuing to deliver Decanter’s editorial content to the Chinese-speaking wine community. She has completed her studies towards the WSET Diploma and Sake Level 3, and is a WSET-qualified educator.</p>

title: ‘It has been a defining decade for the Cape’s wine industry and the next 10 years are even more exciting’
content: <p>Victoria Mason MW is a wine buyer covering multiple regions for The Wine Society. Formerly senior fine wine buyer at Bordeaux Index, she previously worked in retailer Waitrose’s wine buying team, where her regions initially included Loire and South Africa. She became a Master of Wine in 2024, winning the Quinta do Noval Award for the best research paper by a new MW, on regenerative viticulture in Stellenbosch, South Africa. </p>

title: Cru Mendoza: Three terroirs where Argentine wine is being taken to new heights
summary: Three crus with a lot to say...
content: <p>Alejandro Iglesias was born in Buenos Aires, Argentina, to a family where gastronomy and wine always occupied leading roles. In 2004, he changed his career as a Financial Adviser to begin his studies at the Argentine School of Sommeliers. Since then, he has worked as a wine writer for several Argentine and international media publications, as well as being a Decanter contributor. As a wine educator, he teaches classes in Argentina, Uruguay, Panama and Costa Rica. Since 2010 he has been the Executive Sommelier at Bonvivir, the largest wine club in Argentina and in 2013 he launched Vinomanos.com, the first Argentine wine app. As a member of the Argentine Sommeliers Association (AAS), he participated in the organising committee of the Best Sommelier Competition in <a href="https://www.decanter.com/wine/wine-regions/mendoza/">Mendoza</a>, Argentina. Alejandro Iglesias was a judge at the 2019 Decanter World Wine Awards (DWWA).</p>
